title: Agent file offers
description: An agent offers frozen copies of workspace files to the person in a conversation; the conversation's notice carries the offer. App-origin reads, the owner's session only: GET /api/v1/file-offers[?conversation_id=pi:UUID] (the person's offers, or one conversation's), GET /api/v1/file-offers/<offer_id> (one offer and its files' facts), GET /api/v1/file-offers/<offer_id>/inline/<path> (one file for the app's own image, audio and video elements: those types announced, every other file opaque octets as an attachment; HTTP Range), GET /api/v1/file-offers/<offer_id>/download/<path> (always an attachment named after the file; HTTP Range) and GET /api/v1/file-offers/<offer_id>/zip (the whole offer as one stored zip, an attachment the page names). GET /api/v1/file-offers/<offer_id>/thumbnail/<path> returns a bounded JPEG (longest side 320 px, at most 128 KiB) or 404 when unavailable; only JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP inputs up to 64 MiB and 16 million pixels are decoded, under process time and memory limits. Each path segment is percent-encoded. Every byte response carries a sandbox CSP, nosniff and no-store. A removed offer is 404.

path.description: A path inside the offer: relative, clean, no hidden components.

offer.description: One frozen offer. The title is agent text, shown as data; folder is the offered directory's name when one directory was offered. Nothing says the person has downloaded anything.

item.description: One frozen file and the facts read from it when it was frozen. The kind comes from the name, checked against the bytes where that is cheap; a fact that could not be read is absent.

archive.description: A zip's listing from its central directory, never extracted: all entries counted, at most 100 named.

list.description: GET /api/v1/file-offers[?conversation_id=pi:UUID]: the person's offers, or one conversation's, newest first, at most 200.

manifest.description: GET /api/v1/file-offers/<offer_id>: one offer and its files in path order.
